ideas.pitch: A tool that uncovers hidden anomalies in open data and unstructured logs to find overlooked indicators before they become critical.
ideas.problem_statement: Not everything worth discovering is right in front of you. Some ideas exist just beyond the obvious, waiting to be noticed, explored, and brought to life.
ideas.title: Subsurface Signal Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the hackathon's core tagline and theme of discovering the unexpected, appealing strongly to judges looking for non-obvious utility.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered audio and telemetry log analyzer designed to detect silent distress signals in sheltered and farm animals from ambiguous datasets.
ideas.problem_statement: Not everything worth discovering is right in front of you. Some signals are easy to miss, but the best builders never ignore them.
ideas.title: Unseen Animal Welfare Insights
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly appeals to sponsor Mercy For Animals by targeting hidden or neglected indicators of animal well-being using advanced processing.
